scope: Official BWM versus five-epoch adapter on held-out episode-42 window with counterfactual actions
summary: The five-epoch adapter improved causal action response and optical flow but regressed visual, background, temporal, and terminal metrics, so promotion was rejected.
evidence: Action-causal margin improved 0.005644 to 0.007880 and flow EPE improved 0.4140 to 0.3718.
Future SSIM fell 0.95836 to 0.94930, background MAD rose 0.00708 to 0.00753, temporal-gradient error rose 0.001591 to 0.001764, and endpoint SSIM fell 0.94690 to 0.93594.
lessons: Action-encoder-only adaptation on two clips creates an action-response versus visual-stability tradeoff.
limitations: This is one released-demo window and may overlap original BWM training; it is not a benchmark test or physical execution.
next_actions: Inspect the naturally saved early-stop checkpoint without further fitting to the held-out window.
